readout_other: von Frey and thermal thresholds, motor and social scores; common peroneal nerve conduction velocity and SNAP amplitude; thermocouple at DRG; Fluoro-Jade and H&E staining
direction_notes: A single liFUS treatment to the L5 DRG reduced mechanical allodynia for about 5 days, thermal allodynia for 24 h, and leg guarding for up to 4 weeks; nerve conduction velocity rose and SNAP amplitude fell for about 30 min.
safety_notes: First-degree skin burns in 3 animals, wound breakdown and an activity-related hematoma in the first cohort; DRG temperature rise up to 12.8 C in one animal; no histological damage on Fluoro-Jade or H&E.

timing.protocol_description: Single treatment of 25-30 W for 3-4 minutes under anaesthesia with a water-cooled array; the optimal dose was 25 W, 2.475 MHz, a pulse of 38 Hz at 50% duty cycle for 3.5 minutes, raised to 28 W in larger animals.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Preliminary experiments with 8 swine established the working parameters needed for treatment.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Return to baseline motor scores lasted up to 4 weeks post-liFUS after a single treatment.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: Ultimately, we determined the optimal dose to be 25 W, with a frequency of 2.475 MHz and a pulse of 38 Hz at a 50% duty cycle for 3.5 minutes and a coolant rate of 26 ml/min at 17°C.

flags.reason: Stated as 'a pulse of 38 Hz'; taken as PRF. Frequency, PRF and duty cycle are for the optimal dose only.
Only electrical power (25-30 W) is reported; no pressure or intensity values.

Two cohorts of 8 and 4 pigs; Table 1 lists only 7 of the 8 in the first cohort. No control group.
